description: This PHP source file defines a class 'RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber' that acts as an event subscriber for handling specific exceptions during HTTP request processing. It subscribes to Symfony's Kernel exception events and, upon catching a 'RequestForwardableException', forwards the request to another controller.

classes.name: RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for exception events during HTTP request processing and forwards requests when a specific exception occurs.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the Kernel's EXCEPTION event to the handler method 'onExceptionEvent'.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the ExceptionEvent; if the exception is of type RequestForwardableException, it forwards the request to a different controller and stops further event propagation.
